explanation: Requested phi* = 370 deg is outside the valid [0, 360] range. Since 370 - 360 = 10, this is simply the same azimuthal angle wrapped around the circle, so it was normalized to phi* = 10 deg. With that correction, the point (W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0.5, phi*=10 deg) passed all preflight checks (kinematic threshold, cos(theta*) pole safety, Q2 positivity, beam-energy accessibility, lookup-table coverage, vcut sanity) for the eta channel, so the EXCLURAD input file was generated.
